sheet_from: Data/World38/Tile*.OZJ, from MuMain, decoded under a kr_ prefix (Ruins; kl_ and kt_ are kept for the Relics and the Tower): assets/textures is one flat pool, and other worlds own the bare Tile* names. TileGround03, TileRock04 and TileWood01 ship as one flat white placeholder (14,320 bytes each), worn by 72 drawn tiles and 7 overlays; ours, marked: kr_tileground03.png is a copy of TileGrass02's dark earth, kr_tilewood01.png of TileRock03's dirt, kr_tilerock04.png of TileRock07's packed earth. Copies and not the same file, because the ground's loader names each surface by its pair of images. TileRock01 is MU's own copy of TileGrass01's painting. docs/worlds/kanturu-port.md Part B 3.
slot_note: World38 ships TileGrass01.OZT, dark olive tufts on slot 0, and TileGrass02.OZT, pale blue-white wisps on slot 1 (the manifest's `grass` grows slot 0 only for now). A broken ring of mossy industrial ruins round a black NoGround chasm (44.8% of the map), with a cratered plateau of packed earth (TileRock07, 40.5% of the drawn ground) in its middle; the camp in the south-west (16-80, 174-222).
material_note: Read off the art; the names lie. TileGrass01 is mossy olive ground with clover, and TileRock01 the same painting: grass. TileGround01 bright moss: grass. TileGrass02 dark earth with dead grass, TileRock03 dirt and pebbles, TileRock07 the plateau's packed brown earth, and the three placeholders copied from them: sand, the soft-ground material (there is no earth material). TileGround02 moss over buried brick: cobble. TileRock02 red-brown cracked earth and TileRock05 the pits' pebbles and stones: rock. TileRock06 mossy paving: flagstone. TileWater01 the pools under the falls: water.
